topic_title: Top 9 Dog Breeds With Gorgeous Curly and Wavy Coats You’ll Love
intro: If you’re drawn to dogs with beautiful curls or waves in their coats, you’re in for a treat. These medium and small-sized breeds showcase stunning textures that make them stand out in any crowd. From soft rings of curls to gentle waves, their coats not only look charming but often have a delightful bounce and feel. Whether you want a dog with a playful personality or a loyal companion, these breeds combine charisma with coat styles that are truly captivating. Let’s explore some of the most gorgeous curly and wavy-coated dogs you might just fall in love with.

picks.description: The Sussex Spaniel might not be the first breed that springs to mind when thinking about curly or wavy coats, but its thick, slightly wavy fur is truly unique. This medium-sized spaniel has a dense coat that helps it stand out with a rich golden liver color and a soft, feathered texture that gives it a charming old-fashioned appeal. Its waves are subtle but add a lovely dimension to its appearance, making it a lovely choice for those who appreciate a more understated wavy coat. Beyond looks, the Sussex Spaniel is known for its calm and friendly demeanor, making it a steady companion.
picks.best_for: Lovers of gentle, laid-back dogs with unique coats
picks.quirky_fact: The Sussex Spaniel has a distinctively low-slung, almost dachshund-like body shape that makes its waves even more noticeable.

picks.description: The Field Spaniel boasts a silky, moderately wavy coat that’s both elegant and practical. Medium in size, this breed’s coat sits close to the body but has enough wave and feathering to catch the eye. Its rich liver or black coloring combined with the coat’s subtle waves gives it a sleek yet textured look. This breed is often a bit shy but very loyal, and its coat requires regular grooming to maintain those soft waves and keep it looking its best. It’s a lovely option for those who want a spaniel with a touch of curl and a sweet disposition.
picks.best_for: Families looking for a devoted medium-sized dog with a wavy coat
picks.quirky_fact: Field Spaniels were once considered a rare breed, making their coat an even more special sight.

picks.description: True to its name, the American Water Spaniel has a curly to wavy coat that’s both weather-resistant and eye-catching. Medium-sized with a dense, water-repellent coat, this breed’s curls are tight but not overly so, offering a charming, soft texture that feels bouncy to the touch. Its coat color ranges from liver to chocolate brown, adding warmth to its curly charm. This breed was originally bred for hunting in water, so its coat is designed to dry quickly and protect against the elements, but today it’s also cherished as a lively, affectionate companion.
picks.best_for: Active families who love water and want a wavy-coated dog
picks.quirky_fact: The American Water Spaniel is the official state dog of Wisconsin, known for its curly coat and versatility.

picks.description: The Cocker Spaniel is famous for its beautiful coat that features soft waves and feathering that cascade around its ears, chest, and legs. This medium-sized breed’s coat is silky and smooth, with gentle waves that add a lovely texture without being overly curly. Its expressive eyes and lush coat make it an enchanting companion, and it comes in a variety of colors from solid black to rich blends. Keeping the coat looking its best means regular grooming to prevent tangles and maintain that soft wave that gives Cockers their signature charm.
picks.best_for: Those who want a classic, elegant dog with soft waves
picks.quirky_fact: Cocker Spaniels were originally bred as hunting dogs, prized for their keen nose and graceful coat.

picks.description: If you’re captivated by dense, corkscrew curls, the Lagotto Romagnolo is a standout. This medium-sized Italian breed is known for its woolly, curly coat that’s both thick and springy. Originally bred to hunt truffles, its curls help protect it from rough terrain and harsh weather. The coat is low-shedding and feels soft, with tight curls all over the body that give it a teddy bear-like appearance. Beyond being strikingly beautiful, the Lagotto Romagnolo is intelligent and affectionate, making it a great fit for families who want a unique curly-coated dog.
picks.best_for: Families seeking a curly-coated, smart, and affectionate companion
picks.quirky_fact: The Lagotto Romagnolo’s curls actually helped it sniff out truffles in the Italian countryside.

picks.description: The Soft Coated Wheaten Terrier lives up to its name with a silky, wavy coat that’s soft to the touch and always catches attention. This medium-sized terrier’s coat ranges from pale beige to a warm wheaten color, with waves that flow naturally without tight curls. Its coat has a lively bounce and a somewhat fluffy quality, giving it a friendly, approachable look. Known for being cheerful and lively, Wheatens are a great fit for active families who want a dog with a distinctive, wavy coat that’s also low-shedding with regular grooming.
picks.best_for: Active families wanting a friendly dog with a soft, wavy coat
picks.quirky_fact: Despite being a terrier, the Wheaten’s coat is softer and less wiry than many others in the group.

picks.description: Miniature Poodles are known for their elegant, tight curls that cover their entire body, creating a plush, cloud-like appearance. Their coat is dense and springy, making them one of the most recognizable curly-coated breeds. These small dogs carry themselves with a graceful air, and their curls come in a variety of colors, from classic black to apricot and cream. The Miniature Poodle’s coat requires regular grooming to keep those curls defined and healthy, but it’s a rewarding effort for anyone who loves a dog with a stunning, distinctive look and an intelligent, lively personality.
picks.best_for: People looking for a smart, curly-coated companion in a smaller size
picks.quirky_fact: Miniature Poodles have been bred for centuries for their curly coats and versatility.

picks.description: The Toy Poodle offers all the charm of larger Poodles but in a petite package, with tight, luxurious curls that give it a plush, velvety feel. Their coat is dense and springy, often styled in various cuts that highlight those beautiful curls. Toy Poodles are known for their alert and friendly nature, and their elegant curly coat is a big part of their appeal. Though small, they carry a confident presence, and their coat colors range widely, offering plenty of visual variety. Regular grooming is key to keep their curls looking their best, making them a great fit for those who enjoy pampering their pets.
picks.best_for: Those wanting a small, curly-coated dog with personality
picks.quirky_fact: Toy Poodles are among the most popular small curly-coated dogs in the US.

picks.description: The Bichon Frise is synonymous with soft, fluffy curls that give it a cloud-like silhouette. This small breed’s coat is dense with loose, bouncy curls that form an irresistibly soft texture. Their white or cream-colored coats often look like a fluffy powder puff, and they require regular grooming to maintain that signature look. Bichons are cheerful, affectionate, and sociable, matching their charming coat with an equally delightful personality. Their coat’s wavy curls and plush feel make them a standout in the curly-coated world, perfect for someone who values both appearance and character.
picks.best_for: People seeking a cheerful, small dog with soft, curly coat
picks.quirky_fact: The Bichon Frise’s name means “curly lap dog” in French.

faqs.question: Which dog breeds have naturally curly coats?
faqs.answer: Breeds like Miniature Poodles, Toy Poodles, Lagotto Romagnolo, and Bichon Frise are known for their naturally curly coats that range from tight corkscrew curls to soft, fluffy ringlets.

faqs.question: Do curly and wavy coated dogs need special grooming?
faqs.answer: Yes, dogs with curly or wavy coats generally require regular grooming to prevent mats and tangles. Brushing a few times a week and professional grooming every 4-6 weeks help maintain their coat’s texture and health.

faqs.question: Are wavy coats easier to maintain than curly coats?
faqs.answer: Wavy coats tend to be easier to manage because they are less prone to matting than tight curly coats. However, all dogs with textured coats still benefit from regular brushing and grooming to keep their fur looking its best.

faqs.question: Can small dogs have curly coats too?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Breeds like Toy Poodles and Bichon Frise are small dogs with beautiful, curly coats. Their size makes them great companions for people living in apartments or with limited space.
